name: Roofing
metaDescription: The 2026 Roofing Industry Report from Sherlock Research: market size, growth forecasts, competitive landscape, and local benchmarks for U.S. roofing operators.
ogDescription: Market size, growth, competitive landscape, and local benchmarks for the U.S. roofing services industry. 40+ pages, instant PDF.
heroDescription: Comprehensive data and local insights to help roofing contractors win more bids, price storm work confidently, and grow with the cycle.
summary: Market size, growth forecasts, competitive landscape, and local benchmarks for U.S. roofing contractors and service companies.
lead: The U.S. roofing industry continues to grow on the back of aging housing stock, intensifying weather events, and a steady reroofing cycle. Operators who navigate insurance, materials inflation, and labor shortages well are taking outsized share.

market.label: U.S. roofing services
market.note: Placeholder estimates pending sourced figures. Projections are computed by the build from the latest actual year and the CAGR, so the chart always matches the stated growth rate.

reviews.title: Won a contested neighborhood after hail
reviews.text: After a major hail event we used the Sherlock report to figure out exactly which suburbs had the highest reroof intent and lowest competitor density. We routed our door-knockers there first and locked in 38 jobs in a week.
reviews.cite: James K., Owner, regional roofing contractor

reviews.title: Restructured pricing after the report
reviews.text: The pricing benchmarks showed we were under-billing on architectural shingle upgrades by 15–20%. Adjusted the proposal template the same week and average ticket on residential reroofs jumped immediately.

reviews.title: Made the metal-roof decision
reviews.text: We'd been debating adding standing-seam metal as a service line. The local demand data plus the competitive scan made it obvious there was room. Launched a metal division and it's now 22% of revenue.
reviews.cite: Tony S., Owner, growing residential roofer
